title: Netherstorm
body: Netherstorm was once the Plains of Farahlon, green country that a Kirin Tor mage could compare to Westfall only months ago. When Ner'zhul's portals tore Draenor apart it was left a scatter of floating islands at the edge of the Twisting Nether, and now the forces of Prince Kael'thas are finishing the ruin: from Tempest Keep his blood elves work great manaforges that pull energy from the sky, and the strain is tearing the land apart. Ethereals, goblins and the Burning Legion all have their own business here.

title: Area 52
body: Area 52 is a walled goblin town on the southwestern island of Netherstorm, headquarters of B.O.O.M., the Braintrust of Orbital Operations and Mechanics, whose pride is the half-built X-52 Nether-Rocket meant to cruise the Twisting Nether. Bruisers keep the peace on neutral ground. A netherologist warns that the storm will rip the region apart within months; the rocket-chief's only complaint is that the timetable must move up. Envoys of the Aldor and the Scryers argue constantly at its inn.

title: The Manaforges
body: Four great purple engines of Kael'thas stand across Netherstorm, B'naar, Coruu, Duro and Ara, where warp-masters gather the energy of the sky and send it through underground pipes to Tempest Keep. Their magisters siphon great amounts of it in seconds through bloodgem shards. Duro is slipping out of its masters' hands, swarmed by mana creatures, and Ara, the last and best defended, has demons working openly beside the Sunfury.

parts.body: The forges are naaru craft, built on the designs of Tempest Keep, and they carry the failsafe such constructs share: a shutdown begun at the console with the overseer's crystal.
sources: quest 10189 description (manaforge, large purple buildings, Captain Arathyn's ballista team)

parts.body: The energies in the pipelines run far higher than this broken land can bear: unless the forges are stopped, what remains of Outland may be shattered.
sources: quest 10189 description (manaforge, large purple buildings, Captain Arathyn's ballista team)

parts.body: Exposure to so much raw energy magnifies the blood elves' hunger for magic far beyond its natural measure, enough to explain, a Scryer says, why Kael's followers let him get away with so much.

title: Kirin'Var Village
body: Kirin'Var Village was built by the Kirin Tor mages of the Alliance expedition once they knew they were trapped in Outland, and it held for twenty years against the orcs. It did not survive Kael'thas, once of the Kirin Tor himself, whose forces leveled it in a blinding flash. Now the dead keep the village, while at its heart Archmage Vargoth lies sealed in the Violet Tower by a curse no member of the Kirin Tor may cross.

parts.body: The attack opened with a mana bomb, whose blast tore a rift in the nether through which mana creatures still stream into the village.
sources: quest_template 10179 description (Vargoth: expedition trapped, Kirin Tor contingent built Kirin'Var on the Plains of Farahlon)

parts.body: The tower fell to betrayal as much as force: the archmage's apprentice Naberius, drawn to necromancy, gave its defenses to the blood elves and has since become a lich.
sources: quest_template 10179 description (Vargoth: expedition trapped, Kirin Tor contingent built Kirin'Var on the Plains of Farahlon)

parts.body: With the keystone of the curse destroyed, Vargoth was free, though from what he had seen of Farahlon he doubted he wanted to go outside at all.

title: Tempest Keep
body: Beyond the Tempest Rift at Netherstorm's eastern edge, the fortress of Tempest Keep hangs apart from the land, a creation of the naaru that Prince Kael'thas made his seat. It is the reason the manaforges exist: their energy flows to it. Its satellites are the Mechanar, the Botanica, the Arcatraz and the Eye, and from Shattrath the naaru A'dal sends champions to break into them and bring the prince to account.

parts.body: Champions from Shattrath fought their way into the Eye, where Kael'thas held court, and struck him down. Word spread that Kael'thas Sunstrider was dead.

title: The Stormspire
body: The Stormspire is the seat of the Consortium in Netherstorm, a towering spire flanked by eco-domes where talbuks and lashers thrive under the ethereals' shields. At its summit Nexus-Prince Haramad, leader of the Consortium, receives visitors only as a holographic image, a precaution against his many enemies. Below, dealers sell everything from exotic weapons to rare creatures.

parts.body: What Haramad truly wanted was the ata'mal crystal of draenei legend, said to make its bearer like a god. When the one who won it from the Legion simply handed it over, he sent it on to A'dal.

title: Manaforge Ultris
body: Manaforge Ultris is the forge that failed. A tear in the nether gapes atop it, and through it came Dimensius the All-Devouring, a void lord, who proclaims that he is infinite and in time all will be devoured. The blood elves lost both forge and mine. The Ethereum patrol the plateau around it, and on the island to the east the ethereal Protectorate keeps a watch post, fighting both.

parts.body: The Protectorate's commander tells the ethereals' story: they fled their homeworld, K'aresh, shortly before Dimensius ravaged it, and the Ethereum, its old rulers, have hunted him ever since.
sources: creature_text 21504 group 1 (Ultris was a complete disaster)

parts.body: Behind their defenses the Ethereum draw on the forge's void energies to remake themselves as nexus-stalkers. They are not hunting the void lord: they mean to become void.

title: Socrethar's Seat
body: Socrethar's Seat is a craggy island off the northwestern corner of Netherstorm, from which the eredar Socrethar directs the Burning Legion's campaign; no road reaches it, only a Legion teleporter that answers to his stone. Nearby the Legion assembles fel reavers at its forge bases and stages its armies, and among the draenei Socrethar's name is infamous.

parts.body: High Priestess Ishanah of the Aldor remembers him: Socrethar was once a renowned warrior of the Light, and pride was his only flaw.
sources: quest 10407 description (island in the northwest only his most trusted lieutenants can access, teleportation stone)

parts.body: At Manaforge Ara the shutdown uncovered what Socrethar stands behind: Kael'thas Sunstrider has allied himself and his army with the Burning Legion.

title: Celestial Ridge
body: East of Manaforge Ultris, the Celestial Ridge is a forest of arcane crystals where nether dragons nest in every stage of growth, hatching and maturing quickly on the strange energies that forged their kind in the destruction of Draenor. An ethereal trader wants their essence for a client he would rather not name, while two quiet watchers at the north end of the ridge hope to understand the dragons before others rush to exploit them.

parts.body: One of the watchers, Tyri, is properly Tyrygosa of the brood of Malygos, a blue dragon, who hopes to win the young flight over before a malevolent power does.
